fields.statement: Data-centre projects that had signed grid connection agreements were planned at just over 3 GW by 30 June 2026, per Fingrid's half-year report.
fields.verbatim: Kesäkuun loppuun mennessä liittymissopimusten tehneiden datakeskushankkeiden suunniteltu lopullinen kokonaislaajuus oli hanketoimijoiden ilmoittamien tietojen perusteella yhteensä yli kolme gigawattia.

translation.text: By the end of June, the planned final total of data-centre projects that had signed connection agreements was, according to the project developers' own figures, over three gigawatts in total.

fields.statement: By mid-August 2026 data-centre projects holding connection agreements totalled almost 5 GW planned capacity; Fingrid says signing an agreement does not guarantee the connection.
fields.verbatim: Elokuun puoliväliin mennessä liittymissopimusten tehneiden datakeskushankkeiden suunniteltu lopullinen kokonaislaajuus on hanketoimijoiden ilmoittamien tietojen perusteella yhteensä lähes 5 gigawattia, sisältäen jakeluverkkoihin liittyvät hankkeet.

translation.text: By mid-August, the planned final total of data-centre projects that had signed connection agreements was, per the project developers' figures, almost 5 gigawatts in total, including projects connected to distribution networks.

fields.source_title: Fingrid Oyj — Sähkönkulutus on kääntymässä voimakkaaseen kasvuun (18 Aug 2026)
fields.note: Second probe sentence: 'Liittymissopimuksen tekeminen ei takaa' (HIT) is the caveat that a signed agreement does not guarantee connection.

fields.statement: Fingrid's 3 Sep 2026 study says better placement of new grid connections could raise total transmission connectivity by up to 20 GW, and that projects with signed connection agreements could raise consumption by up to 40% within five years.
fields.verbatim: Sähköverkon liityntäsopimuksen tehneet hankkeet voivat toteutuessaan kasvattaa kulutusta viidessä vuodessa jopa 40 prosenttia.

translation.text: Projects that have signed a grid connection agreement could, if realised, increase consumption by up to 40 per cent within five years.

fields.source_title: Fingrid Oyj — Fingridin selvitys: teollisuuskulutuksen sijoittuminen (3 Sep 2026)
fields.second_verbatim: Fingridin tänään julkaiseman selvityksen mukaan uusien liittyjien tehokas sijoittuminen Suomen sähköjärjestelmään voi kasvattaa kantaverkon kokonaisliitettävyyttä jopa 20 gigawattia.

second_translation.text: According to the study Fingrid published today, the efficient placement of new connections in the Finnish power system could raise total transmission-grid connectivity by up to 20 gigawatts.

counts.note: GR below the 4-record target: two dated items verified, plus three held for dates or confirmation. SE has one blocked release. Context facts count as records here.

reading_notes: Greek article banners show the capture day (for example 'Τρίτη, 20 Οκτ 2026'), not the publication date. Round 2's Kryoneri date (2026-10-20) appears to be that banner. Check the body date before filing any Greek news item.
Fingrid's 'liityntäsopimus' (connection agreement) is a different thing from a 'liittymissopimus' (connection contract) and the release uses the first term. Keep the Finnish wording verbatim.
Strong sources for the FI context block: Fingrid (sttinfo.fi) releases, which are first-party, probe clean, and give dated gigawatt figures. Use them as context_fact on FI, not as project records.
